# Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'), (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'), (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not contain positive values")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All three input matrices must have the same shape")
    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a numeric value")
    if np.isnan(tau_filter) or np.isinf(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
    # Step 1: Normalize decreasing future-token weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    sum_raw = np.sum(raw_weights)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / sum_raw
    # Step 2: Compute weighted future-token loss
    L_plus = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_no_call = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)
    # Step 3: Use the stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)
    # Step 4: Keep calls that meet the filtering threshold
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter
    return keep, margin
